speaker: Barbara Rentler

speaker: Adam Orvos
title: EVP and CFO at Ross Stores
msg: Thank you, Barbara. As previously mentioned, our comparable store sales were up 4% for the quarter, driven by a combination of higher traffic and basket size. Cost of goods sold during the period improved by 60 basis points. Distribution and buying costs levered by 70 and 55 basis points, respectively, while domestic freight costs declined by 15 basis points. As expected, merchandise margin decreased by 80 basis points. speaker: Adam Orvos

speaker: Adam Orvos

speaker: Adam Orvos
title: EVP and CFO at Ross Stores
